Node.js Nacos addon: Rust `src/*.rs` via `nacos-sdk-rust`/`napi-rs`; generated `index.d.ts`. Config/naming clients use async Promises; subscriptions use `ThreadsafeFunction`. `Option<T>` maps to `T | undefined | null`; errors become JS `Error`.

**Build dependency**: require `nacos-sdk-rust` and `napi`
yarn build:debug
Target-specific builds: `yarn build --target <target-triple>`
Compiled native addon: `nacos-sdk-rust-binding-node.<platform>.node`
TypeScript definitions: `index.d.ts` (auto-generated)

AVA tests (3-minute timeout):
yarn test __test__/index.spec.mjs
Note: Tests require the native addon to be built first (`index.node` must exist).

CI targets: see `.github/workflows/CI.yml`. If build fails, ensure Rust toolchain is up to date: `rustup update stable && cargo update`. Cross-compilation: consult CI Docker setup. Loading errors may indicate platform/architecture mismatch.

`NACOS_CLIENT_LOGGER_LEVEL`: default `INFO`; logs `$HOME/logs/nacos/`
`NACOS_CLIENT_COMMON_THREAD_CORES`: default `1`
`NACOS_CLIENT_NAMING_PUSH_EMPTY_PROTECTION`: default `true`

**removeListener/unSubscribe**: NOOPs; Rust SDK lacks removal.
**Clients are stateful**: Each client maintains persistent gRPC connections; create once and reuse for the application lifecycle
**Auth methods**: HTTP token (username/password) or Alibaba Cloud RAM (access_key/access_secret).
